chunks: Dharih asked Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام.
About the muhrim undergoing cupping, he said: "Yes, if he fears the blood."

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abū ʿAbdillāh, Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام
key_terms.الدَّمَ: blood, indicating the condition connected to the permission
key_terms.الْمُحْرِمِ: a person in the state of iḥrām for hajj or ʿumrah
key_terms.ذَرِيحٌ: Dharih, the questioner and narrator in this report

ai.seo_question: Can a muhrim in iḥrām undergo cupping (ḥijāmah)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a muhrim in iḥrām and whether he may undergo cupping. Imam Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام permits it in a case of need, specifically when there is fear related to blood.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2652 - Dharih asked Abu Abdullah (as) about a Muhrim undergoing cupping (hijamah).
Imam (as) said: "Yes, if he fears harm from the blood."
